name: Anicca
description: Anicca is a daily affirmation app for iPhone, built to be the answer to rumination, depression, OCD, a hard day, a hard life, and laziness: it learns what you struggle with and sends one short, honest line at the moment you need it. You pick the areas you want support with — self-criticism, overthinking, anxiety and more — enable notifications, and receive short affirmation cards during the day. There are no streaks and nothing to catch up on when you miss a day. Free to download, with an optional in-app subscription. Anicca is a support tool, not a medical treatment.
capabilities: Daily affirmation cards delivered by notification
Personalized support topics (self-criticism, overthinking, anxiety, and more)
Support for rumination, depression, OCD, hard days, a hard life, and laziness — a support tool, not a medical treatment
No streaks and nothing to catch up on after a missed day
